distance_span_decisions.principle: A finite exponential kernel needs an explicit support. Choose three e-folding lengths (5% residual at the boundary), then derive the longest link from the writer's existing radius. This is a mechanism decision, not a fitted measured quantile.

fuzzy_null_registration.no_alternative_evidence: When there are no alternative candidate pairs, halve calibrated node evidence to represent lack of a sample for the null. This pre-registered finite-sample rule prevents identical edgeless singletons from scoring either zero or vacuous certainty; it does not alter candidates or optimize against a corpus.
fuzzy_null_registration.rule: After alignment, average all candidate-matrix similarities except the selected correspondence for each mapped query node; include all candidates for unmatched query nodes. If no alternative pairs exist use null 0.
